basis:
J-FWD screw-dependent rows re-issued for the ruled screw IN718 M5 x10 (ENG-HW-101-IN718), lead 11:25Z item 2, 11:41Z, 12:09Z item 5,
relay 12:28Z.  Mechanical, 2026-10-20, v2 (v1 script 0ab9a77a473efeeb / json 753a3d7954bf1490 not published, superseded).  [DERIVED] from
SIM (FEA3D js5 complete run + seat patches (a) and (a')); no new run.  CALC / DERIVED, not physical approval.

v2: (1) the envelope is FEA3D's 12:21Z three-history envelope (js5, (a), (a'); results/v352/jfwd_soak_envelope_v352.json 1d970741cb95a885,
read through relax v5 which cross-checks it): SOAK70 N max 6389 (a), SOAK 7383 (js5), SOAK52 6742 (a'); (2) the k_b bracket of relax v5
(lo on (a') SOAK70 5627.3 N, hi on (a) SOAK70 6389.1 N); (3) FEA3D's TC-01 ligament-station P+Q is scaled per history (js5 only reports
that station: N_IN,js5 / N_js5) and carried as INFORMATION (contact-edge field, 0.08 mm from the hole wall, like the hole-edge line class
of 239 (9)); the envelope-scaled value is quoted beside it; (4) the TC-02 A_n thread-shear FULL ROW (lead 12:09Z item 5) with the
engagement basis and the cheapest fixes and their slack effect.

Basis (stated per row in the output):
 - FE ANCHOR = the worst of the sharp-edge histories per state and per quantity (lead 11:41Z): highest screw N, lowest seat window,
   lowest MS per line, highest screw section moment.  A4-80 values are the FE's own (the FE screw is A4-80); IN718 is mapped onto them.
 - IN718 screw force per history h and state: N_IN = F_V + (N_h - F_V) x r, r = (model IN718 soak gain) / (model A4-80 soak gain) at that
   state's temperatures (relax v5 joint model; max over the k_b bracket; F_V = 3750 N, the FE preload).  dF_S / dF_V = 1.000 in the
   model at every soak state, so the J-F1 maximum 4096 N adds 346 N.  Rows are given at 3750 N (the FE basis, as FEA3D's cells) and at
   4096 N (the J-F1 maximum: 239 (3) 'strength checks at the maximum preload'; 239 (8)(a) P+Q at 3750 and 4096 N).
 - force-driven rows scale with N_IN / N_h on the FE row of the same history (screw tension, thread shear, flat bearing, under-head band,
   Pm line counts): conservative where part of the stress is thermal and of the same sign.
 - seat / ring-line P+Q: (i) model-consistent, P+Q x F_sh,model(IN718) / F_sh,model(A4-80) (the lines track the shell pull, relax v4
   item 4); (ii) bound, P+Q x N_IN / N_h.  The row is (i); (ii) is quoted beside and flagged where the two straddle zero.
 - screw moment for IN718: M_h x E ratio (imposed rotation) x max(1, F_c,IN / F_c,h) (the extra screw force goes to the seat contact,
   K_C / (K_C + k_sh) of it): the product, conservative.
 - allowables: IN718 Fty / Ftu(T) AMS 5662/5663 minima (Special Metals SMC-045, engmat DATASHEET); AL6061-T6 engmat (10,000 h basis,
   LITERATURE); TC-02 thread Fsy = 0.577 Fty, Fsu = 0.6 Ftu (FEA3D's rule, back-computed from its cells and verified); FEA3D's Neuber
   (eps = s / E + 0.002 (s / Fty)^n, n 15 and 30, eps_limit of the node, the lower MS) reproduced exactly on js5 SOAK.
 - TC-02 A_n: FEA3D's cell A_n = N / tau = 63.48 mm2 = the strip area of jfwd_v352 at L_eff 6.35 mm (= the v3.5.1 engagement 6.85 less the
   0.5 mm mouth, the jfwd_preload v2 basis).  The v3.5.2 spot-face engagement is longer (jfwd_seat_v352_v1: L_e 7.287 CAD, 7.257 at the
   drawing minimum of the f7 plug): quoted as a BASIS CHECK for FEA3D, not credited in the row.
 - every row within 0.05 of zero (or negative) is flagged for an FE confirmation (lead 11:25Z).

FA1S_tap_bearing.note: FEA3D tap_bearing_derived sigma 106.0 at V 3603.6 (d x L_e 34.00 mm2, L_e 6.85), allowables back-computed (330.6 / 407.6 MPa); V-driven, the same for every screw grade

TC02_thread_shear_full_row.basis: tau = N_IN718 (envelope history, per state) / A_n; Fsy = 0.577 Fty(T), Fsu = 0.6 Ftu(T) at FEA3D's TC-02 thread temperature; A_n = jfwd_v352 strip area (M5-6H / 6g: Ds_min 4.826, En_max 4.605, P 0.8) x L_eff

a_lower_J-F1_max.note: on FEA3D's A_n; the J-F1 band at 3.0 N m is 2250-4096 N: a maximum near 4000 N cuts the low-K tail of the lot (J-F1 acceptance statistics decide the reject rate); +0.05 would need a maximum below the 3750 N nominal (not practical)
a_lower_J-F1_max.slack_effect: none: the 24-case minimum is set by the 2250 N installation (relax v5: seat -205 / ring +89 N at 2250 N, hi end)
a_lower_J-F1_max.other_effects: none on CAD or FD-04; J-F1 acceptance rule only

b_custom_IN718_length.slack_effect: none: the free length (grip + 0.5 mouth) is unchanged; in the VDI-form resilience of jfwd_embed the engaged thread is 0.5 d / A_d3 and the tapped part 0.33 d, independent of L_e, so k_b and the 24-case do not move
b_custom_IN718_length.other_effects: no CAD change (tap 4.2 x 9.0 / full thread 8.0 kept), no head-height or FD-04 change; J-F1 calibrates K at the flight length; drawing length tolerance +/-0.08..0.1 instead of ISO js15
b_custom_IN718_length.note: credits the v3.5.2 spot-face engagement (head on the flat at r 31.31) that FEA3D's A_n (v3.5.1 6.85) does not; FEA3D to confirm the A_n basis

c_helical_insert.part: Boellhoff HELICOIL plus M5 x 0.8, 1d / 1.5d (order no. 4189 005 0005 / 4189 005 0075)
c_helical_insert.source: RS 471-017 (mfr part 41890050005): 'Drill Size 5.2mm', 'Thread Length 5mm' (https://uk.rs-online.com/web/p/thread-repair-inserts/0471017, accessed 2026-10-20); HELICOIL plus datasheet 0180/10.02 (https://docs.rs-online.com/5ddb/0900766b810150a0.pdf, accessed 2026-10-20) lists M 5 x 5 / 7.5 / 10; its STI tap table (pp. 36/37) is not in that file: the STI major diameter is TO-SOURCE
c_helical_insert.tap_wall_effect: torch-passage tap wall 1.906 mm at az 18 / 342 (measured from the M5 major 5.0): the tap drill grows 4.2 -> 5.2 (-0.50 mm on the drilled wall) and the tapped major grows from 5.0 to the STI major (each 0.1 mm of diameter thins the 1.906 wall by 0.05 mm; at an STI major near 6.0 the wall is about 1.41 mm, the M6-fallback value): probe + FE re-run needed
c_helical_insert.slack_effect: a coil insert adds thread compliance (k_b down, slightly favourable); not quantified without data
c_helical_insert.other_effects: CAD + TC-02 drawing change, insert installation / tang removal on flight hardware, new J-F1 pair (IN718 / insert)

fixes.d_disc_spring_interaction: a disc spring under the head that is solid (flat) at the soak force leaves the soak force and this row unchanged; only a spring still active at the soak would lower it (jfwd_spring_v352)
